svg.title: Orange Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Public exhibition review identifies Orange Curve (1964–65), oil on canvas, National Gallery of Australia. Primary American Masters record describes this orange curve. Off-white upper/lower-left painted corners retained; curved orange field touches left edge and occupies whole right edge. Physical dimensions unresolved; normalized to full rectangular support shown in reproduction. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
